name: arogyabot
description: ArogyaBot — Emergency & Health Intelligence Platform (web + Android via Capacitor)

scripts.android:setup: npm run build:web && cap add android && python3 scripts/patch-android.py && python3 scripts/make-android-icons.py && cap sync android
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.android:debug: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.test: cd tests && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm test
